title: Host SSH connection reuse
summary: Host control shares a per-host, user and credential OpenSSH master through a private socket under the executing workstation's Yoke scratch root. The master persists for 30 idle seconds. A diagnosed pre-execution stale-socket failure warns host_control_ssh_stale_socket and retries once without sharing; ambiguous disconnects never retry remote commands. Socket setup failures name host_control_ssh_socket_unavailable and ask for a short writable temp_root. Source behavior awaits live timing proof.
